rules.title: Pass and Redstone rules
rules.heroDesc: These rules apply to LogHome Pass, Super LogHome Pass, and Redstone services.
rules.heroDate: Effective date of this version: August 1, 2026

plans.title: Pass plans
plans.subtitle: Pricing and validity
plans.rule1: Monthly plans last 30 days and annual plans 365 days; benefits start immediately after payment.
plans.rule2: Renewing the same tier extends from your current expiry date. The actual charge and new expiry date are subject to the confirmation page and server response.

upgrade.title: Upgrades and auto-renewal
upgrade.subtitle: Check and manage anytime
upgrade.rule1: Upgrading from LogHome Pass to Super LogHome Pass charges only the tier difference for the remaining days; the expiry date stays the same.
upgrade.rule2: Downgrades are not supported while a Super LogHome Pass is active; you can choose a new tier after it expires.
upgrade.rule3: With auto-renewal on, Log is deducted automatically at expiry for the current billing cycle. If your balance is insufficient, renewal fails and benefits end at expiry.
upgrade.rule4: Turning off auto-renewal does not end active benefits early; your pass remains usable until the expiry date.

grant.title: Redstone grants
grant.subtitle: Member grants and monthly grants for regular users
grant.rule1: Regular users receive 6 Redstone each calendar month. If you have an active pass that month, you won't receive the regular monthly grant as well.
grant.rule2: Monthly passes grant Redstone on activation and after each successful renewal. Annual passes grant once at activation, then monthly.
grant.rule3: When upgrading from Standard to Super, the difference between the two tiers' grant amounts is added for the current period.
grant.rule4: Redstone from pass grants, upgrade top-ups, and regular monthly grants is valid for 3 months from the date it arrives.

exchange.title: Redstone exchange and spending
exchange.subtitle: Every change is recorded
exchange.correctionCost: Free for standard · Smart correction free with a pass · Standard 2
exchange.rule1: Paid AI actions deduct the amount of Redstone shown on the page. If you don't have enough Redstone, no paid task is created.
exchange.rule2: Spending uses the earliest-expiring granted Redstone first, then permanent exchanged Redstone. Redstone from Log exchanges never expires.
exchange.rule3: Reconnecting or resubmitting the same task won't charge you twice. Exchange, gift, and spending records are all available in Redstone Center.
exchange.rule4: If exchange rates or feature costs change, the amounts shown on the page before you act apply.

gifts.title: Gifts and codes
gifts.subtitle: Benefits go to the chosen account
gifts.rule1: Before gifting, check the recipient and pass plan. Once sent, benefits go to the selected friend's account.
gifts.rule2: Codes must be valid to use. A code cannot be reused; the tier and duration are subject to the redemption confirmation.
gifts.rule3: If you already have a pass, redeemed benefits extend or upgrade it according to the plan.

exclusive.title: Member-only features
exclusive.subtitle: Available while benefits are active
exclusive.rule1: Scheduled publishing is available only to LogHome Pass and Super LogHome Pass members; membership is checked when you create a task.
exclusive.rule2: Two-person collaborations (the owner plus one collaborator) are free. For three or more collaborators, the owner needs a Standard or Super LogHome Pass; otherwise collaborators can only preview the work and cannot edit, add or delete chapters, reorder, or publish.
exclusive.rule3: Other member-only features are marked on their feature pages. After your pass expires, new actions no longer include member privileges.

rules.note: If this page differs from earlier descriptions, the confirmation page, current rules, and actual server results prevail.
